RaggieSoft StoreTrainer — PC Game & Trainer Organizer (v1.0 • v1.1 • v2.0)

RaggieSoft StoreTrainer is a free desktop organizer created by Michael P. Ragsdale for keeping your classic and modern PC games paired with their companion game trainers (cheat utilities), launch options, and personal hotkey notes. Originally hand-written between 2018 and 2020 inside a Windows 2000 Professional SP4 setup before AI tools existed, StoreTrainer now spans three preserved generations that all share the same simple My StoreFiles (.stf) profile library!

🗂️ Browse Official GitHub Repository (v1.0 Archive, v1.1 Retro & v2.0) → 💾 Download Classic Pre-AI Installer: tssetup100.exe (v1.0) 🔍 Inspect Source Code (20 Files) → 📦 Inspect Setup & Upgrade Scripts →

Three Generations, One Shared Library

StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern Desktop & RaggieSoft Launcher Edition): Features a live searchable My StoreFiles sidebar, Favorites pinning, drag-and-drop game and trainer setup, automatic window-ready launch timing, personal hotkey notes, and trusted trainer file safety checks — while smoothly upgrading classic v1.0 and v1.1 installations in place.

StoreTrainer 1.1 (Classic Retro Edition) & Frozen 1.0 Archive: Keeps full support alive for vintage Windows 95, Windows 98, and Windows 2000 gaming PCs with File Explorer double-click .stf launching, launch delays, a Recent Files menu, and RaggieSoft Launcher discovery — right alongside the untouched 2018–2022 pre-AI historical archive.

Saved Game Profile (.stf) Format

Every StoreTrainer edition saves each game profile in Documents\My StoreFiles as a clean, human-readable text file (MyGame.stf) that works interchangeably across retro and modern PCs: 

[General]
STF.Version=1.1
DisplayName=Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2
Category=Strategy & Simulation
Favorite=true
LaunchDelay=3

[Game]
LaunchGameFirst=true
Path=C:\Games\RA2\ra2.exe
Switch=-win

[Trainer]
TrainerLaunchesGame=false
Path=C:\Games\Trainers\ra2_trainer.exe
Switch=

Choose the Right Edition for Your PC

StoreTrainer Edition Supported PCs Highlights
StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern Edition) Modern Windows Desktops & Laptops (via RaggieSoft Launcher or Standalone Setup) Live searchable library sidebar, drag-and-drop, hotkey notes, trainer file change warnings, Light & Dark themes, and automatic in-place upgrade from v1.0 or v1.1.
StoreTrainer 1.1 (Classic Retro Edition) Windows 95, 98, ME, NT 4.0 SP3+, Windows 2000 SP4, XP, Vista, 7, 8.1, and newer Double-click .stf launching, /l & /e switches, launch delay timer, Recent StoreFiles menu, in-place patcher from v1.0, and RaggieSoft Launcher discovery.
StoreTrainer 1.0 (Pre-AI Historical Archive) Preserved byte-for-byte in github.com/raggiesoft/storetrainer 100% untouched 2018–2022 historical snapshot (tag v1.0.0-pre-ai) documenting Michael P. Ragsdale’s pre-AI desktop craftsmanship.
